notes.title: The Goblin Dungeons Demo is Now on Steam!
notes.content:
Welcome, adventurers!

We’re excited to announce that the demo version of Goblin Dungeons is now available for download on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3423540

Dive into a dark fantasy RPG with adult content (18+), where you play as a powerful — and delightfully defiant — sorceress venturing into goblin-infested dungeons in search of ancient artifacts... and some wicked fun.

🔥 In the demo:
[list]
[*] The first dungeon to explore;
[*] Bold scenes with mature content;
[*] Magic system to master;
[*] Dark fantasy atmosphere with erotic and humorous elements.
